raw_definitions: Definisi : vt menggoncangkan: he ~d the keys in his pocket, dia menggoncangkan kunci dlm sakunya. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
Definisi : vi bergemerincing, bergerincing: her bracelets ~d as she danced, gelang-gelang tangannya bergemerincing sewaktu dia menari; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : n 1. metallic clinking sound, bunyi /gemerincing, gerincing/: the ~ of coins, bunyi gemerincing duit syiling. 2. catchy verse, song used in advertising, etc, dendang: advertising ~s, dendang iklan; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
